_about: R-631 slice A: the one list of where personal data really goes and is kept. One row per flow; the columns are design note R-631 section 7. The test apps/dashboard/test/legal/dataFlows.test.ts reads the code and fails when an outside address, library, table, storage binding or Android backup rule is not on this list (or on data-flows-allow.json), and when a row points at code that is gone. 'code' says where each row is in the code; it is for the test, not for the notice. 'unknown: ...' means the fact could not be read from the code. This repo is public: no real names, numbers or e-mails here.
